Thank you for contributing to MedOrbits! Please complete this template so reviewers can understand the purpose, scope, implementation, and impact of your changes.

> **Review policy:** Submitting a pull request does not guarantee approval or merging. Required reviews, automated checks, and applicable security reviews must be completed first.

### Maintainer Review

Merge only after required reviews, relevant checks, and necessary security, data-integrity, and deployment reviews are complete.

**This template documents the review process; it does not enforce repository permissions, required approvals, or CI checks by itself. Configure GitHub repository rules and branch protection separately.**
